problem: Equal corresponding three sides imply equal included angles. The candidate also gives full triangle congruence and all three corresponding angles.

proof_idea.original: The source uses superposition and I.7 to force the competing apex to coincide.
proof_idea.analytic: The existing independently proved SSS metric law gives corresponding dot products. The signed-cosine bridge converts equal adjacent lengths and dot products into each corresponding angle relation.

        $geometry::main::is_triangle(p, q, r)

    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(q, r)

    geometry::main::distance_sq(r, q) = geometry::main::distance_sq(q, r) = geometry::main::distance_sq(v, w) = geometry::main::distance_sq(w, v)
    by thm geometry_lemmas::angle_congruence_from_equal_sides_and_dot(r, p, q, w, u, v) => $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(p, r, q, u, w, v)
